items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Another one of the pianists that greeted me, who immediately made friends with me when I first went to New York was Thelonious Monk.

ctx.x: In New York I had heard him play quite a bit, and the pianist... Another one of the pianists that greeted me, who immediately made friends with me when I first went to New York was Thelonious Monk. He used to go out of his way to take me different places where things were happening, and listen to different musicians. And Bud was also a good friend of Monk's.

One night we were in the Yacht Club. I think it had changed to the Downbeat then. And there was a jam session going on after hours. Because Charlie Parker was there... And Jimmy Dorsey had never heard of Charlie Parker. Jimmy Dorsey came in, and it must have been just before the club was closing, because Jimmy Dorsey, I don't know, he gave the club owner some money and told him to close the doors and give everybody a drink -- and most of the people in there were musicians.
